issues: FIXED: pairwise contact loop never rechecked A.dead inside the inner j-loop — a cell drained to death mid-loop by transfer(G,B,A) kept dealing spike damage and could keep engulfing other cells that frame using its stale cached radius (biomass already scattered as corpse motes at die()); added `if (A.dead) break;` at the top of the inner loop.

FIXED: init() only ensured G.cells existed and then pushed 27 NPCs — re-initializing on a reused G (restart path) would stack populations toward the 64-cap alongside stale evolved cells; init now removes every non-player cell before seeding the starting populations.

NOTE (accepted, not changed): enzyme perk energy bonus (14*1.3) is applied to the player only — the spec's '(player only for dna/stats)' parenthetical is ambiguous, but NPCs benefiting from a player DNA purchase is nonsensical; player-only is the coherent reading.

NOTE (accepted, not changed): the 3-vs-6 DNA tier for eaten NPCs keys off the prey's PEAK biomass radius rather than radius at death — prey always dies below biomass 3 (radius ~13.8 < 26), so a literal at-death check makes the 6-DNA branch unreachable; peak size is the only reading that makes the tier meaningful.

Verified clean: exact shared numbers (accel thrust*8/sqrt(mass), drag 0.6+stat, metabolism 1.1+0.02m+2.2th, eat 1.22/0.85 @14/s death<3, mote +2/+14/+0.25, photo 2.2, chl dna 0.02*n*light, mito 0.5/4, starvation 2.5, regen 1.2, visc 1.25, split 0.48 one mutated child, immigration 0.004/s, hues, radiusOf everywhere); caps (motes 240 spawn / 280 hard, cells 64 at init+division+immigration); lane discipline (no drawing, no wave/shot/virus logic, hooks called not implemented); first-frame safety (missing player, empty arrays, G.hooks fallback); no Math.random, no stray globals; rising-edge divideReady; NaN guards on all normalized vectors.
notes: Loop caps (stated in the header comment): cells <= 64 including player; motes spawn cap 240 with a hard cap of 280 so corpse scatter can briefly overflow, and <= 18 corpse motes per death; 3 upwellings; pair loop ~2k iterations; mote scans (AI nearest-mote + grazing) ~18k distance checks per frame. Ambiguities resolved: (1) the enz perk energy bonus applies to the player only — perks are player purchases, and the spec's "(player only for dna/stats)" reads as scoping the shared formula to whoever eats; (2) "dna += 3 (small, r<26) else 6" on eaten NPCs is judged by the prey's PEAK-biomass radius (tracked per cell as `peak`), since radius at death is always < 26 once drained below 3 biomass; (3) "eased" light = smoothstep applied to 0.5+0.5*sin(time*0.05); (4) NPC mutation uses GEN.mutate's full default organelle pool so the ecosystem can evolve anything; (5) G.time/G.tick are assumed advanced by main's loop — sim only reads time; (6) stats.deaths and stats.divisions are left to main (playerDeath/uiDivide are main's), while sim maintains motes, cellsEaten, dnaEarned, peakMass, timeAlive; (7) Spitters graze motes when energy < 50 so they don't starve while holding standoff range; (8) sim's death sweep also processes hp lost to combat's shots/viruses ("Death (any cell)" is sim's job); (9) win fires exactly once per init when colonyBuds reaches 4, with a 'bond' fx; (10) a mild non-spec separation impulse is applied on non-engulfing contact so cells don't stack; (11) upwellings are stored at G.world.upwell (extra field, mutate-in-place friendly). Cells carry per-frame caches _st/_r plus a `peak` field; genome slots follow the hex layout (rear outer 13/12/14 for flagella, front 7/18 for spikes/sensor).

Loop caps: shots 80, viruses 40, cells 64 (all enforced/respected); worst-case pair work per tick is virus-cell 40*64, shot-virus 80*40, shot-cell 80*64 distance checks — trivial at 60fps. Per-cell stats/radius are precomputed once per update. Ambiguities resolved: (1) wave.n counts COMPLETED waves — spawn uses n for count 4+2n and virus hp 8+n, clear pays 10+2n then increments n, and the next countdown uses the incremented n in max(45, 75-4n); G.wave.next is treated as a countdown in seconds (matches the UI's "<=10s" display). (2) The potent perk multiplier (x1.5 on dmg 12) is applied to player-fired shots only — NPC hostile shots stay 12, since perks are player purchases. (3) NPC fire cooldown is unspecified; chose 0.9/(1+0.25*(shot-1)) (player keeps the exact 0.55 formula), and NPC firing applies to any NPC with stats.shot>0 within sensor range 260+vision*400 at the nearest strictly-smaller cell, with a rough intercept lead — Spitters at spawn, mutants later. (4) Viruses home at fixed speed 95 with a 3.2 rad/s steering cap so they arc and are dodgeable; body radius 7px for contact; retarget to nearest living cell when their target dies; wave spawn targets = 60% player bias else random of the 3 largest living cells. (5) Shots vanish past R*1.02 ("nothing exists outside R") and combat only applies damage/flash — sim owns death, biomass scatter, and playerDeath at hp<=0. Wave clear also credits G.stats.dnaEarned alongside stats.waves. fx types emitted: 'wave' (start at rim, clear at player), 'hit', 'die' (hue 320 for phages); sfx names: 'wave','clear','shot','spit','pop','hit','hurt' — main may map or ignore.

issues: fx entries with t0===0 never expired: `t - (f.t0 || t)` treats a valid time-zero timestamp as 'now', so age is 0 every frame; such fx accumulate to the 120 cap and render forever as full-brightness ghosts (verified in harness: 120 stuck entries). Fixed with an explicit null check.

Zoom sanity clamp Math.min(4,...) violates the camera contract: required zoom for the 17%-of-min(W,H) player diameter is ~5.2 at 1080p (binds on any screen with min(W,H) > ~830px), shrinking the player to ~13% and skewing perceived vision scaling. Raised guard to 20, which never binds for legitimate values.

Shot streak line widths used world-space floors (Math.max(3, 6/z) / Math.max(1.2, 2/z)); at typical play zoom ~5x the glow rendered ~16+ screen px thick instead of a slim streak. Made widths screen-constant (6/z, 2/z).
notes: Loop caps: 90 shimmer dots (fixed, seeded), motes bounded by sim's 240 cap, cells 64, shots 80, viruses 40, fx hard-capped at 120 in the render pass, die-burst limited to 12 dots per fx; composite-mode switches limited to 4 per frame (bg/rim source-over -> shimmer+motes lighter -> cells/buds source-over -> viruses/shots/fx lighter -> overlays source-over), and motes/shimmer are batched into single-path fills. Ambiguities resolved: (1) shimmer needs seeded-but-render-local randomness, so I used a tiny mulberry32 PRNG keyed off G.seed instead of G.rng() — calling G.rng from render would perturb the shared seeded sim stream frame-dependently (Math.random is never used); (2) 'zoom scaled by 1/vision' implemented as zoomTarget = 0.17*min(W,H)/(2*playerRadius)/stats.vision, clamped to [0.12,4]; (3) 'when dead follow corpse site' keeps the last alive position AND the last zoom target frozen until respawn; (4) mote '2px glow dots' interpreted as screen pixels (sizes divided by zoom) so they stay crisp at any zoom; (5) fx entries carry only {type,x,y,t0,hue}, so per-type durations (eat .45s, hit .38s, die .9s, bond 1.15s, wave 2.2s, default .5s) live in render, which consumes/removes expired fx as spec'd, and 'wave' ripples are drawn on the dish rim at world origin; (6) colony buds are drawn as r=11 mini cells with the player's genome/hue orbiting at playerRadius+24 with a golden adhesin tether, under the player draw order-wise but after NPCs; (7) camera state persists in G.cam (mutated in place, snap-initialized on first frame) with frame-rate-independent lerps 1-exp(-rate*dt) at 4/s position and 2/s zoom.

issues: eraCount() counted the free starting flagellum (dna:0, unlocked from the start) as an era-1 'purchase', so Era 2 unlocked after only one real purchase instead of the specified two; fixed by counting only unlocks with a DNA cost > 0.

Minor (not changed): CLOSE/CANCEL falls back to setting G.screen='play' directly when main provides no uiClose hook — a small lane stretch, but the spec defines no close hook and the fallback prevents a dead button.
Minor (not changed): palette popover can clip a few px at the panel's left edge for inner-ring slots; cosmetic only.
LEAD FIX: hud(G) guarded against null player on the title screen (pre-start crash at ~100ms).
notes: Loop caps: exactly one rAF loop exists (the mutate-screen genome preview, a single 220px drawCell per frame) and it self-terminates the moment the screen changes; hud() runs at main's ~10Hz on a fixed cached node set with zero DOM creation per call; tree and mutate panels rebuild only on open (tree also after a buy click). Smoke-tested in node with a DOM stub plus the frozen genome contract: init, full show() cycle, all hud() branches (countdown/active wave/era accent/visc maxhp), preview frame, slot-click palette, and era-gating rerender all pass; 354 lines. Ambiguities resolved: (1) wave.next is treated as the absolute game-time of the next wave (countdown = wave.next - G.time), matching its initial value 75 at t=0. (2) Era-reach for tree locking is computed locally and cumulatively — era N open iff era N-1 open AND >=2 purchases (unlocked organelles + bought perks, the free starting flagellum counts) in era N-1 — while the HUD era name/accent read G.era as main's authority. (3) Tree CLOSE (and a mutate CANCEL button I added so the divide modal isn't confirm-only) call G.hooks.uiClose when main provides it, else fall back to setting G.screen='play' and showing the HUD. (4) init() ends with show(G, G.screen||'title') so the page isn't blank if main defers its first show(); harmless if main calls show immediately. (5) HUD is shown only on the 'play' screen; modal screens re-enable pointer events per spec while the HUD stays click-transparent.
